children: Australian shares were likely to open little changed on Monday, with potential losses in mining stocks outweighing likely gains in the energy sub-index as renewed U.S.-Iran strikes in the Middle East drove oil prices up.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) marginally fell 0.01%, a 3.9-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark lost 0.2% on Friday.
